model.architecture: Qwen3.5-0.8B gated-delta hybrid (18 GatedDeltaNet linear-attention + 6 gated full-attention layers, KV budget 4096) post-trained for page-level document parsing, plus the checkpoint's own 12-layer 768-dim ViT (no DeepStack) wired to fast_vlm at static 512x512; MTP head dropped

variants.quantization: int8 decoder (dynamic on linears + embedding; convs and the delta rule stay float, fp32 activations declared) + fp16 vision encoder / int8 vision adapter - vision quant gated on document fixtures: fp16enc+int8adp end-to-end corr 0.9998+ on table/formula/arXiv pages

recommended.reason: verified on macOS (Metal); GPU decode ~2.9x CPU on M4 Max, OCR output byte-identical to CPU on the table-page gate
verified on iPhone 17 Pro (Metal): decode 48.5 tok/s vs 18.0 CPU; peak 3.8 GB GPU vs 0.9 GB CPU

platform_notes: Requires litert-lm >= 0.15 (hybrid state binds via ExecutorMetadata)

This is a document parser, not a chat model: the OCR post-training erodes general chat (it transcribes prompts instead of answering) - prompt it with the upstream transcription prompt and a page image
Vision input is static 512x512: pages must be legible at that size; dense small-print pages degrade into paraphrase/repetition (checkpoint behavior at this resolution)
Run OCR with --attachment <page.png> and the upstream reference prompt (see model card); image is placed before the text prompt automatically
GPU inference runs with fp32 activations (declared in the bundle) - GPU peak memory ~3.8 GB on iPhone 17 Pro vs ~0.9 GB CPU

known_issues: General-chat sanity gates score low (Mac 8Q: 3-4/8) with a transcription/echo failure mode - checkpoint behavior from the OCR post-training, not quantization damage (anchored against the HF fp32 original)
Dense academic pages at 512x512 transcribe correctly at the start then drift into repetition; upstream's own reference code ships a repeat-cleanup post-processor for this
